metadata.summary: A minimal declarative example comparing equal parts of a rectangle.
objectives: Relate one of two equal parts to one half

sources.title: Original mathematical example
sources.reference: Project-authored rectangle divided at its midpoint
sources.note: Illustrative fixture; level codes are examples, not curriculum claims.

steps.title: Start with the whole
steps.text: This rectangle is one whole shape.
steps.alt: The outline of the whole rectangle is emphasised.

steps.title: Compare the parts
steps.text: The left and right parts are equal in size. Each is one half of the whole rectangle.
steps.alt: Both halves are shown side by side inside the rectangle, with matching dimensions.

accessibility.summary: A rectangle split at its midpoint has two equal halves.
